column1: # The checks of shell/keyword-kinds.nsh: hii keyword set of a DATE, a TIME, an ORDERED_LIST and
# STRINGs through the Keyword Handler, which writes each VALUE as given (UEFI 2.11 §35.3.2), and
# refusals before any call, which dmpstore shows wrote nothing. See check-shell-log.sh.
# TerminalDxe prints a character outside ASCII as "?" unless the serial terminal is VT-UTF8, so
# the checks of texts that cite "§" compare them with "?" in its place.
# KindStore as publish-hiidb creates it: 2024-03-31 at byte 0, 12:34:56 at byte 4, the items 1, 2
# and 3 at byte 8, the EFI_HII_REF of QuestionId 4 and FormId 1 at byte 12, and the empty STRINGs
# KindString at byte 34 and KindText at byte 42
# the DATE suppresses its year: a VALUE that keeps 2024 sets 2024-04-01

column3: (.error_message | gsub("§"; "?")) == "keyword KindDate: VALUE=010407e9 of question \"Kind date\": the year of this DATE is suppressed (UEFI 2.11 ?33.2.5.4.6), and set writes it as 2024, not 2025"

column1: # the TIME suppresses its second: a VALUE that keeps 56 sets 13:00:56

column3: .error_message == "keyword KindTime: VALUE=382218 of question \"Kind time\": hour 24 is outside 0 to 23"

column1: # the ORDERED_LIST, last container first: the items 3, 2 and 1

column3: (.error_message | gsub("§"; "?")) == "keyword KindList: VALUE=010003 of question \"Kind list\": cannot set question \"Kind list\": a container after an empty one holds a value, where set writes 0 after the last item (UEFI 2.11 ?33.3.8.3.53)"
.error_message == "keyword KindList: VALUE=000101 of question \"Kind list\": cannot set question \"Kind list\": the ORDERED_LIST takes each option once (EFI_IFR_UNIQUE_SET): \"First\" is given twice"

column1: # set does not write the EFI_HII_REF of a REF, which keyword set refuses with set's error

column3: (.error_message | gsub("§"; "?")) == "keyword KindRef: cannot set question \"Kind ref\": set does not write the EFI_HII_REF of a cross-reference question, the target of its link (UEFI 2.11 ?33.2.5.4.10)"

column1: # one SetData() of a DATE and an ORDERED_LIST: 2024-12-31 and the items 3 and 1
# a STRING's VALUE holds its MaxSize CHAR16s last byte first, NULL-padded: "AB"
# the multi-line STRING takes a line feed: "A", LF, "B"
# 4 characters, where the last CHAR16 holds the NULL

column3: (.error_message | gsub("§"; "?")) == "keyword KindString: VALUE=0044004300420041 of question \"Kind string\": cannot set question \"Kind string\": the STRING takes at most 3 characters, its last CHAR16 of MaxSize 4 holding the NULL (UEFI 2.11 ?33.2.5.4.9), not 4"

column1: # a character after the NULL, which set does not write

column3: .error_message == "keyword KindString: SetData() writes VALUE=0000004200000041 as given, where set writes 0000000000000041 at VarOffset 34 for question \"Kind string\""

column1: # U+E000, of the Private Use Area

column3: (.error_message | gsub("§"; "?")) == "keyword KindString: VALUE=000000000000e000 of question \"Kind string\": cannot set question \"Kind string\": '\\u{e000}' (U+E000) lies in the Private Use Area, U+E000..U+F8FF, which UEFI 2.11 ?33.2.6.2.1 prohibits"

(.error_message | gsub("§"; "?")) == "keyword KindString: VALUE=000000000000d800 of question \"Kind string\": its character 0 is CHAR16 0xd800, a UTF-16 surrogate, which UCS-2 has no character for (UEFI 2.11 ?33.2.6.2.2)"

column1: # a line feed in the single-line STRING

column3: (.error_message | gsub("§"; "?")) == "keyword KindString: VALUE=00000042000a0041 of question \"Kind string\": cannot set question \"Kind string\": the STRING is single-line (no EFI_IFR_STRING_MULTI_LINE, UEFI 2.11 ?33.3.8.3.70), so it takes no line break"
.error_message == "keyword KindString: VALUE=00420041 is not as wide as question \"Kind string\""
.error_message == "keyword KindString: its <KeywordResp> has &READONLY, and SetData() writes no read-only keyword"
